## Parties

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into by and between Stonecrop Labs Inc ("First Party") and Thistle Yard Foods Ltd ("Second Party"), each referred to individually as a "Party" and together as the "Parties". This Agreement takes effect on 4 March 2026 (the "Effective Date") and is entered into in connection with the Parties' discussions and dealings concerning a licence of a data set (the "Purpose"). Each Party may act as a disclosing party and as a receiving party under this Agreement.

## Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by or on behalf of one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party"), whether before or after the Effective Date, in writing, orally, electronically, visually or by inspection of tangible objects, that is designated as confidential at the time of disclosure or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, data sets and samples, extracts and derivatives thereof, data schemas, field definitions, collection and processing methods, technical data, software, source code, designs, specifications, know-how, business plans, forecasts, pricing and licence terms, customer and supplier information, and the existence and contents of this Agreement and of the Parties' discussions concerning the Purpose.

Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession, without obligation of confidence, before disclosure by the Disclosing Party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party free of any obligation of confidence; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

## Obligations

Each Receiving Party shall hold the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall use it solely for the Purpose and for no other purpose, including any competitive purpose. The Receiving Party shall apply at least the same degree of care it applies to its own confidential information of like importance, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care.

The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent, except to its employees, officers, directors, affiliates and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out here; the Receiving Party remains responsible for any breach by such persons. The Receiving Party shall not copy, reverse engineer, decompile or otherwise exploit the Confidential Information, and shall not use any data set disclosed hereunder to train, validate or benchmark any model or product, except as reasonably required for the Purpose.

The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party on becoming aware of any unauthorised use or disclosure of Confidential Information. If disclosure is required by law, regulation or court order, the Receiving Party may disclose only the portion legally required, giving the Disclosing Party prompt written notice where lawfully permitted so that protective relief may be sought. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information in its possession, subject to retention required by law or contained in routine backup systems.

## Term

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a term of 48 months.

## Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the law of the State of Delaware.
